# The busiest street where bikes ride among the cars, given a cycle track of its own.
bike = network.layer("bike")
mixed = {link for link, kind in zip(bike.link_ids(), bike.link_infrastructure()) if kind == 0}
cyclists = before.link_bins_table(layer="bike").to_pandas().groupby("link")["travellers"].sum()
street = cyclists[cyclists.index.isin(mixed)].idxmax()
track = [link for link in mixed if link.split(":")[0] == street.split(":")[0]]
tracked = base.replace(network=ms.network_edit(network, bike_facility={link: "separated" for link in track})).run(
    "delft-track"
)
